subject: Field Collector browser offline queue and reconnect retry

browser.execution: headless Playwright with a fresh isolated context and temporary profile
browser.service_worker: candidate app shell and vault helper cached before offline navigation

fixture.api: all /api/mobile/* requests intercepted and answered by local synthetic fixtures

limitations: The browser used network emulation while the host remained online; this was not OS airplane mode or physical-device acceptance.
Mobile API behavior was mocked, so this does not verify authenticated live Gateway sync, candidate enrollment, consent withdrawal, or server persistence.
The existing user browser vault and its contents were not opened, unlocked, or modified.
Real OIDC, owner-transfer re-enrollment in a user browser, human retention/erasure disposition, tenant/RLS, and production media/provider recovery remain open.
